> On Apr 18, 2017, at 5:37 PM, David <djtma...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hello,
>
> Suppose I want to read in variables X_1, X_2, ... X_K in the data block of a stan program. Variable X_k has length N_k, which could vary across k. I don't think stan currently supports ragged arrays, so I can't bring them in as a single object. Is there a way to bring them in as a loop rather than having a separate assignment statement for each variable?
>
> Thanks!
